freeze_precedes_results_PROOF.statement: Frozen before any human calibration label existed and before any Selene prediction on the calibration sample was produced. Measured, not asserted.
freeze_precedes_results_PROOF.interpretation: All eight label fields are empty across all 180 rows and no calibration prediction artifact exists, so these thresholds cannot have been chosen in response to observed agreement.

threshold_status: PROJECT-LEVEL acceptance thresholds for this study's risk profile. NOT claimed to be universal thresholds from the literature.

structural_gate.automatic_failure: any systematic truncation, or any semantic branch shown to be inaccessible, fails regardless of semantic agreement

M1_EVIDENCE_FAITHFULNESS.rationale: a false PASS lets an unsupported draft claim be treated as grounded

M2_REFERENCE_SOURCE_CORRECTNESS.rationale: safety-critical; a fluent but materially incorrect claim must not routinely pass
M2_REFERENCE_SOURCE_CORRECTNESS.required_mechanism: REFERENCE_SILENT_BUT_SOURCE_SUPPORTED escape path must remain operative

M3_CORE_COMPLETENESS.rationale: larger legitimate human-boundary component, so a lower agreement gate; but gated in BOTH directions because systematic one-sided rejection is not acceptable

TARGET_ALIGNMENT.rationale: wrong-target drafts are a major failure mode; sensitivity to sibling substitution must be retained

M4A_RETRIEVAL_CLAIM_SUPPORT.unit_of_qualification: ATOMIC support decisions, NOT the derived continuous recall scalar
M4A_RETRIEVAL_CLAIM_SUPPORT.note: the per-KC scalar is deterministically derived from atomic labels and is not required to match a human scalar exactly

EXPLORATORY_HOLISTIC_EVIDENCE_ADEQUACY.note: no gate; not used. Demoted for construct-validity failure and may not be re-promoted, including if its numbers improve.

human_gold_resolution.disagreement: adjudicate BEFORE judge qualification, adjudicator blind to Selene prediction
human_gold_resolution.poor_human_agreement_response: flag the construct as potentially insufficiently reproducible; do NOT blame the judge first. Changing the rubric after seeing these results requires formally declaring this validation set BURNED.

decision_rule.m4a_isolated_failure: does NOT invalidate M1/M2/M3/TARGET; report that automated retrieval-reference recall is unvalidated and decide separately
decision_rule.no_averaging: mean qualification score, mean AC1 and overall accuracy are NOT acceptance rules. Qualification is criterion-wise.

anti_contamination: Selene inference on calibration rows completes and is hashed BEFORE any agreement statistic is computed; metrics are not visible while inference is incomplete.
Human calibration data is VALIDATION data, not development data.
M1 PASS recall, TARGET PASS recall, M2 false PASS and M3 false FAILs may not be tuned against it.
If the frozen evaluator fails, it fails - it is not repaired against these labels and re-tested on the same labels.
SENT_032/SENT_033 remain GOLD_PENDING development sentinels, are not calibration rows, and do not block human annotation.
